digest.component_or_area: test suite (Jira DC transport, pagination guard, rate limit, backend registry)
propositions: Five tests have assertions that logically cannot fail: the PAT-repr test does not construct a transport that carries a credential, the pagination-guard teeth test re-implements the predicate inline instead of calling the shared helper, the validate_assignee_exists test only asserts presence not return-value contract, the rate-limit sweep asserts total <= 1 allowing zero calls, and the unknown-backend test does not exercise select_backend
Each vacuous test names a real property in its docstring that is worth testing but currently unchecked; the gap must be closed by rewriting the assertion, not deleting the test

The pagination-guard helper _search_issues_calls_taking_the_default() hardcodes its input source and takes no parameters, making it impossible for the teeth test to feed a synthetic source; parameterizing it with an optional source argument (falling back to the live file) enables the teeth test to call the shared predicate
Mutation-checking each rewrite with production-code mutations (not fixture mutations) must demonstrate that breaking the actual predicate or contract causes the test to fail RED
The validate_assignee_exists contract is implemented and documented correctly on both backends (DC returns username string, Cloud returns accountId), so the gap is purely assertional; no bug is filed
